newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks seen mixed on new accounts day.

text.p: Pakistani stocks are likely to remain mixed on Thursday, the new accounts day, amid sentiment weakened by the suspension of a Karachi brokerage house for defaulting on share transactions, dealers said.

The Karachi Stock Exchange said on Wednesday it would auction M. Rashid Jamal's trading card to settle claims arising from the firm's failure to pay money owed in share transactions and to deliver sold shares on Tuesday's settlement day.
"The index will edge up on new accounts day, but sentiment will be depressed by this default case," dealer Rony Byramjee said. "Violence in Karachi is also causing investors concern."
On Wednesday, the Karachi 100-index fell 8.34 points, or 0.53 percent, to 1,567.45 amid 163 losers and 59 gainers.
Turnover fell to 26.28 million shares from 38.62 million on the previous session.
